changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValueByObjectID] ( @AssetTypeID bigint, @Object varchar(50), @ObjectID bigint, @Code Nvarchar(500) ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select string_agg(results.[value],'') as DisplayValue from (select top 100 coalesce(D.FormattedValue, D.value) as [value] from dbo.AssetType T outer apply ( select TL.value, coalesce(case when TL.Value = 'FirstName' then R.FirstName + ' ' else R.LastName end, F.FormattedValue, case when @Object = 'ReferenceItem' then @Code else Null end, G.Name) as FormattedValue, TF.[index] as [TokenIndex],TL.[index] as [TokenIndexL] from [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(T.DisplayFormat, '{', '|'), '|') TF cross apply [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(TF.[value], '}', '|'), '|') TL left join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = T.ID and FT.Name like TL.Value left join Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.ObjectType = @Object AND F.ObjectID = @ObjectID left join [Group] G on TL.Value = 'Name' and @Object = 'Group' and G.ID = @ObjectID left join reporting.Global_resource R on TL.Value in ('FirstName', 'LastName') and @Object = 'Resource' and R.ResourceID = @ObjectID where RTRIM(TF.value) <> '' and RTRIM(TL.value) <> '' ) D where T.ID = @AssetTypeID order by D.TokenIndex,D.TokenIndexL) results )
